summary.headline: Reliance Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 25% and EBITDA about 10% to over Rs 54,000 Cr, led by O2C spreads, with net profit near Rs 23,200 Cr (+6%).
summary.overview: Consolidated topline rose about 25%, mainly on higher oil prices, with Jio revenue up 12% and retail up about 12% (underlying 11.6% ex-RCPL). Management backed out the Rs 8,900 Cr Asian Paints gain from the prior-year base, so EBITDA of over Rs 54,000 Cr is up 10% on a like-for-like basis. O2C revenue rose 17% to about Rs 17,000 Cr on distillate and chemical deltas, offset by SAED, under-recoveries, a planned turnaround and LPG and gas diversions. Net debt was slightly lower than March at about Rs 1,23,000 Cr, with capex of about Rs 39,000 Cr; Moody's upgraded RIL to Baa1 and S&P is at A-.

financial_highlights.metric: Consolidated EBITDA (recurring, ex Asian Paints gain)

financial_highlights.change: Pressured by higher net finance cost as 5G costs are now expensed
+12% YoY reported-basis adjusted for RCPL; +7.4% reported, +11.6% underlying
Slightly lower YoY; margin down 80 bps

segments.name: Oil to Chemicals (O2C)
segments.commentary: Revenue about Rs 17,000 Cr (+17%) on higher distillate and chemical deltas; refinery run near full capacity (~96-97% throughput) despite a planned turnaround that cut sale production ~10%. EBITDA margin fell YoY, with SAED, under-recoveries and higher crude differentials and freight as drags.

segments.name: Oil & Gas (E&P)
segments.commentary: Revenue up ~3.2% YoY; EBITDA roughly flat. Condensate realisation about $107/bbl; KGD6 ceiling price $8.9/mmBtu, down ~$1.14, expected to rise by at least $1 in H2. CBM output crossed 1 mmscm/d.

segments.name: Jio Platforms
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 39,173 Cr (+11.8%), EBITDA Rs 20,865 Cr (+15.1%), margin 53.3%. 533.3 mn subscribers, 285 mn 5G users, 28.6 mn fixed broadband (14 mn AirFiber); ARPU Rs 215.6 (+Rs 7 YoY); digital services +20%.

segments.name: Reliance Retail
segments.commentary: Revenue about Rs 90,000 Cr; EBITDA Rs 6,309 Cr, margin 7.9% (-80 bps). Digital commerce investment is depressing margins; orders +116% YoY in grocery, 1,000+ big box stores, and 4 mn B2B customers.

segments.name: JioStar
segments.commentary: Total revenue Rs 10,946 Cr (+14%); income from operations up ~30%. IPL 2026 was the biggest ever; 530 mn+ users; linear TV share 34%. Ad revenue was hit by the real-money gaming ad ban and the US-Iran conflict.

segments.name: Consumer / FMCG (RCPL)
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 8,600 Cr, about 2x YoY; beverages Rs 2,900 Cr (>50% growth); daily essentials Rs 3,200 Cr. Management says EBITDA is breakeven; target Rs 1 lakh Cr revenue by FY2030.

segments.name: New Energy
segments.commentary: Solar PV: 1 GW peak of modules produced, targeting 20 GW annual by year end; battery target 40 GWh this year, scaled to 120 GWh. Kutch renewable power expected to flow this year; Samsung C&T green ammonia contract executed.

guidance_outlook: Retail: management targets doubling absolute EBITDA over about three years, with no margin target. Margins expected to dip short term as online scales.
Retail: FY27 is described as a foundation year; online growth is to be funded from existing profits.
KGD6 gas ceiling price expected to rise by at least $1/mmBtu in H2 FY27; rig due next month for KG Basin exploration.
Two additional ethane VLECs: first ship nearing US port loading, next two due in the coming months; ethane and ROGC expected to rise as a share of ethylene feed (currently ~70%).
Global demand expected to be lower in 2026 and rebound in 2027; refining cracks described as reasonably strong. Management declined to guide on the current-quarter run rate.
Jio: no specific guidance; management declined to give forward-looking statements on digital services margins or satellite investment.
FMCG: management expects growth to pick up in the next quarter in home care, personal care and processed food.
capex_capacity: Capex about Rs 39,000 Cr in Q1; management declined to give full-year capex, citing an EBITDA-to-debt and rating framework, and said partners may be evaluated.
Jamnagar 168 MW data centre for Meta, funded on RIL's balance sheet, to be delivered in one shot on a fast timeline (not disclosed).
Battery cell gigafactory ~40 GWh to be commissioned this year; solar cell lines commissioned and expanding; polysilicon construction nearing completion.
Kutch renewable ecosystem: installation to start after monsoon; power to flow once transmission is ready this year.
Partially commissioned large beverage plant (one of Asia's largest) and integrated food park in FMCG; a new edible oil facility is being explored in West Bengal.
Retail: dark store network to expand over the next 9-10 months; 1,000+ big box stores and ~2,221 retail outlets in fuel retail (about 230-240 added YoY).
demand_pricing: O2C: distillate margins up sharply (management said 250-300% on a flat crude basis, before crude differentials). Gasoline cracks $26/bbl (from $10), gasoil $63 (from $16), ATF $62 (from $14).
Brent averaged $104.5/bbl vs $68 in the prior-year period. Middle East OSP premiums reached ~$20/bbl, and freight rose ~10x.
Petrochemicals: polymer demand down 22%; polyethylene most affected, PVC least. Naphtha up 61% to $903/t (above $1,000 at peak).
Retail: transactions +46%, customers +11%, average transaction value falling as digital mix rises. Apparel digital share 27.5%.
Jio: ARPU Rs 215.6, up Rs 7 YoY with no tariff action; organic ARPU improvement cited at 4-5%; promotional offers in Homes business weigh on ARPU.
Gas: India gas consumption down ~10% YoY; PSC gas priority circular rolled back.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 20% digital services growth sustainable, and will its margin converge to connectivity?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give forward-looking guidance but said digital services growth is rising, with more monetisation potential. Margins are currently lower due to investment; they should improve as revenue scales.

qa_highlights.question: Why was ARPU up less than 1% QoQ?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said underlying ARPU is not under pressure. Homes mix and promotional offers weigh on it; organic ARPU growth is 4-5% without tariff action.

qa_highlights.question: How will JioMart's quick commerce investment be measured, and what are its advantages?
qa_highlights.answer: Dinesh Taluja said dark store expansion continues for about 9-10 months, with discipline on unit economics and no chasing of order volume. Advantages cited: 400 mn loyalty members, 20 years of data, presence in 1,000+ grocery markets, and better terms of trade.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a Jio order book or a process for platform services revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Anshuman Thakur gave a generic answer on vertical teams, targets and monitoring; no order book was disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Will the 168 MW Meta data centre be built on RIL's balance sheet, and what is the full-year capex plan?
qa_highlights.answer: The data centre is on RIL's own balance sheet with the group funding it, delivered in one shot on a clear timeline. Capex was not guided; the framework is EBITDA-to-debt and ratings, with partners possible.

qa_highlights.question: Current-quarter profitability and crude availability?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said crude is bought 45-50 days ahead and the outlook is uncertain. Ethane shortfall of 7-8% vs the 1.6 mt design should be closed with new VLECs; no run-rate guidance was given.

qa_highlights.question: FMCG EBITDA and Independence revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Ketan Mody said FMCG is at EBITDA breakeven, improving with scale, and the Independence split will be shared later.

risks_watch: Crude availability and cost: Middle East supply disruption (Strait of Hormuz) persists; crude bought 45-50 days ahead, and management declined to say whether current-quarter profitability is better than Q1.

O2C earnings volatility: SAED, under-recoveries on domestic and PSU sales, LPG and gas diversions, and crude differentials/freight/OSP premiums can offset headline cracks; management said Q1 is not a steady-state number.

Retail margin pressure: EBITDA margin 7.9% (down 80 bps) as dark stores scale; target is to double absolute EBITDA over about three years with no margin target, and dark store expansion runs for the next 9-10 months.

Jio ARPU and digital services margins: ARPU up Rs 7 YoY but only slightly QoQ; Homes promotions weigh; digital services grow ~20% at lower margins than connectivity, and management declined forward guidance on margin convergence.

Capex and funding: Q1 capex about Rs 39,000 Cr with no full-year number; net interest cost rising as 5G costs are now expensed; Jamnagar 168 MW Meta data centre to be funded on RIL's balance sheet, with partners possibly evaluated.
Gas and E&P: KGD6 natural decline; ceiling price $8.9/mmBtu expected to rise by at least $1 in H2; India gas consumption down ~10% YoY; PSC gas priority circular rolled back.

Execution milestones to track: 1 GW solar module output vs 20 GW annual target, 40 GWh battery cells this year, Kutch power flow this year, three ethane VLECs delivery, and FMCG Independence split to be shared later.
key_quotes: So, this has been an extraordinary quarter. Extraordinary when you look at it from point of view of macro volatility.
So, we will go market by market and improve wherever it does not make sense, we will pull back down on that.
We are doing it on our own balance sheet, and it is part of the intelligence business, and we will figure out that whole business will also evolve.
The underlying ARPU is not under pressure.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the reported numbers and the strategic build-out (New Energy, Jio, retail online), but guarded on forward view: management repeatedly declined to guide on current-quarter run-rate, full-year capex, Jio digital services margins, satellite investment and ARPU outlook, calling the environment too assumption-driven. Defensive on the O2C headline, stressing that product cracks overstate profit because of crude differentials, freight and premiums.

growth.why: No numeric revenue guidance; growth rests on high refinery throughput (~96.5%), strong distillate cracks, KGD6 gas price rise to ~$9.9 in H2, and new capacity (168 MW Meta data centre, 40 GWh battery, solar to 20 GW, Kutch power) mostly due in about 2 quarters, with timing not firmly disclosed.
